items.title: ASTRO26 LBA: SWOG S1827/MAVERICK — Phase III brain MRI ± PCI in SCLC
bullets: @OncoAlert (Following + Brain circuit): #ASTRO26 late-breaker LBA 03 — SWOG S1827/MAVERICK, a randomized Phase III of brain MRI surveillance with vs without prophylactic cranial irradiation (PCI) in small-cell lung cancer.
Directly tests whether modern MRI surveillance can spare PCI toxicity while protecting CNS control — highest neuro-oncology-adjacent Phase III overnight.
Clearest brain-surveillance trial beat of the Monday window; full results still rolling out from the ASTRO podium.
items.need_to_know: Top cancer overnight: ASTRO26 Phase III MAVERICK — brain MRI surveillance ± PCI in SCLC.

items.title: I-SABR Phase II: adding immunotherapy to SABR improves OS in early-stage NSCLC (6-yr data)
bullets: @JoeChangMD / @UTMDAnderson via OncoAlert (Brain): Phase II randomized I-SABR at #ASTRO26 — four doses of immunotherapy added to SABR improved overall survival in early-stage NSCLC.
Six-year follow-up: nivolumab + SBRT associated with increased cancer-targeting CD8+ T-cell activity vs SABR alone.
Strongest immuno-radiotherapy OS signal overnight from MD Anderson’s ASTRO podium.
items.need_to_know: NSCLC beat: I-SABR Phase II — immuno + SABR improves OS with durable CD8 activation at 6 years.

items.title: Isatuximab + iberdomide maintenance lifts MRD− rates in NDMM (MIDAS Ph3 follow-up)
bullets: @CancerNetwrk (Brain): isatuximab + iberdomide maintenance increased MRD-negativity rates in the first year among newly diagnosed myeloma patients who stayed MRD+ after induction and transplant.
Phase 3 MIDAS context — longer follow-up still needed for PFS/OS impact of MRD conversion.
Hematologic follow-on to yesterday’s etentamig CERVINO Phase III — maintenance/MRD angle, not another bispecific OS claim.
items.need_to_know: Myeloma beat: isatuximab + iberdomide maintenance drives MRD conversion in post-transplant NDMM.
